explication: Crash Bandicoot Launcher statically recompiles a user-supplied PS1 disc into a native game, then runs it on desktop or Android with graphics, input, saves, configuration, mods, and gameplay enhancements. The main flow is documented by the README and launcher/recompiler references in the source index. Sampled runtime excerpts establish several core dependencies; unsampled feature connections are omitted where their callers are not shown.
